notesGlobal: Native shell/curl and Playwright CLI only; no packages/agent tooling, browse.mjs, snapDOM MCP, or companion extension used. The demo app was served locally solely because the formal protocol requires runtime interaction. As in rep 1, wallMs is accumulated measured command/browser execution time across actions; the interface did not expose a continuous task clock spanning reasoning pauses, so those pauses are not included. tokensObserved unavailable.

entries.answer: Tailscale didn't stop the Hugging Face intrusion | 164
entries.notes: Method: curl plus local parsing. Action 1 read the HN HTML and extracted the title but its regex missed the comment count. Action 2 queried the public HN Firebase topstories and item endpoints and returned the complete answer.
Method: curl to the default branch's raw package.json plus local JSON parsing.

Method: curl plus grep, following a link found in the Argentina article body. Action 1 failed locally because passing the full page through an environment variable exceeded the argument limit. Action 2 found the absolute Mar del Plata href but incorrectly prefixed it. Action 3 followed the discovered absolute URL and confirmed the canonical final URL.
Method: curl to npm's public downloads API for last-week/preact plus local JSON parsing; this supplied the weekly number corresponding to the package page.

Method: curl, then Playwright Chromium fallback. eBay returned HTTP 403 to both methods; Chromium rendered 'Error Page | eBay'. No organic listing could be observed or opened, so the task is honestly unclaimed.

Method: curl plus grep on the Python functools reference. The first three patterns missed or found a different lru_cache example; action 4 extracted the documented signature @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=128, typed=False), confirming 128.
Method: curl plus grep on the Mar del Plata article infobox; read the Partido row as General Pueyrredón.

Method: Playwright CLI against the locally served app, with actual runtime interaction. Opened and snapshotted the page, filled New item with Buy milk, clicked Add, and snapshotted again; the DOM-order list was [Bread, Buy milk]. The same browser session continued into T9.

Method: same Playwright page/session as T8. Clicked Refresh and snapshotted the resulting runtime DOM. The clock advanced and button focus changed, but the semantic grocery list remained [Bread, Buy milk], so the app state did not change.
Method: curl using Wikipedia's own /w/index.php search endpoint with the Obelisco de Buenos Aires query; followed redirects and observed the canonical article URL.
